name: Mint ~Kasuka ni Kaoru, Kaze o Kanjite~
original_name: みんと ～かすかに香る、風を感じて～
source:
One summer night three naked fairies came to hero's room. They decided to live together with him, but hero did not know where to get his eyes since fairies knew nothing about their femininity, feelings of romance or shame. As fairies and hero learn about each other with every new day, what choices will they make?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某个夏夜，三名赤身裸体的妖精来到主人公的房间，决定与他共同生活。可这些妖精既不了解自己的女性身体，也不懂恋爱与羞耻为何物，令主人公完全不知道视线该往哪里放。随着他们日复一日地了解彼此，最终会作出怎样的选择？

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
